item.title: D-Link DIR-895L L2TP Host Name AVP Out-of-Bounds Write (CVE-2026-100740)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — network · CVE-2026-100740 (VulDB 410614; VulDB submission 906303). Status: PoC. Affects: D-Link DIR-895L wireless router, L2TP control channel parser, tunnel set params function in tunnel.c. Tags: dlink, dir-895l, router, l2tp, udp-1701, oob-write, cwe-787, firmware, remote, iot.

item.title: D-Link DIR-600L HNAP SOAPAction Pre-Auth Stack Buffer Overflow (CVE-2026-129354)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — network · CVE-2026-129354 (VulDB 437417). Status: PoC. Affects: D-Link DIR-600L wireless router (hardware revision B1, shared DIR-600Bx platform image); HNAP handler hnap_main in htdocs/cgibin, reached as /usr/sbin/hnap through boa's /HNAP1/ mapping. Tags: dlink, dir-600l, router, hnap, soapaction, stack-buffer-overflow, cwe-121, pre-auth, qemu-user, iot.

item.title: D-Link DIR-600L authentication.cgi Pre-Auth Stack Buffer Overflow (CVE-2026-129353)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — network · CVE-2026-129353 (VulDB 437416). Status: PoC. Affects: D-Link DIR-600L wireless router (hardware revision B1, shared DIR-600Bx platform image), web login handler htdocs/web/authentication.cgi backed by the multi-call binary htdocs/cgibin. Tags: dlink, dir-600l, router, mips, firmware, stack-buffer-overflow, cwe-121, pre-auth, qemu-user, iot.
